units.spine: The Free Elder Council sits as it has always sat, and almost nothing it asks of the households arrives.
A traveller who brings a question to the Free Elder Council is sent away with it, and has it settled the same afternoon by somebody here who holds no title.

units.poolKey: no token matched: unclassified (the plain-description floor)
units.spine: Warmholz is governed by the Free Elder Council, and every matter of the place runs through it.

units.poolKey: capture pressure ADVANCING (weak security, poor prosperity)
units.spine: Nothing here is policed and nothing here is spare, and a place in that state gets cheaper to buy into, not dearer. Nobody has bought it yet… it would be worth knowing who would come for the open mine first.
Business before the Free Elder Council is settled slowly and by agreement, and once settled it is not readily opened again.

units.poolKey: governing body name: a SLOT, never a baked noun
units.spine: People passing through who name the Free Elder Council anything else are put right at once, and politely.
The people of the place are no longer sure the Free Elder Council is theirs, and the Council governs as though it were not sure either.

units.poolKey: legitimacyHold: public rejection is breaking the hold
units.spine: The hold the Free Elder Council had here has gone to the households, and no rival was needed to take it.
